claims.text: Indicated in diabetes with CKD (low GFR or albuminuria) even without HTN;
claims.quote: ACE inhibitors or ARBs are indicated for patients with diabetes and evidence of chronic kidney disease (CKD) (decreased glomerular filtration rate or albuminuria), even in the absence of hypertension

claims.text: first-line for diabetes + HTN regardless of CKD.
claims.quote: They are the first-line treatment for patients with diabetes and hypertension regardless of CKD status.

claims.text: ACE inhibitors also prevent CV events in diabetes;
claims.quote: ACE inhibitors also prevent cardiovascular events in patients with diabetes mellitus

claims.text: recommended for secondary prevention with known ASCVD.
claims.quote: Treatment with an ACE inhibitor or ARB is recommended in patients with known atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) for secondary prevention
